feeds.title: The Left Rough Blog
feeds.description: Golf can be really hard, we understand. To make matters worse, there is a lot of confusing information about golf on the internet. From basic instruction to selecting the right equipment, we can help with simple, easy-to-understand solutions to your golf problems.

feeds.title: Golf Span » Gear
feeds.description: In the following segment, Golf Span shares insights and reviews on Golf Gears. feeds.title: Critical Golf Blog
feeds.description: Launched in the spring of 2009 by co-founders Andrew and Norm, Critical Golf focuses exclusively on providing reviews of golf equipment. We set out to provide consistent, thorough reviews that allow readers to compare products side-by-side. We compare golf equipment across multiple criteria to present a comprehensive picture of which product is best, and why.

feeds.title: Wedge Guys Blog
feeds.description: Blog covers topics related to golf equipment, its usage, golf tutorials and more. The mission at Wedge Guys is to make golf more affordable without sacrificing quality. All of our products are developed by PGA professionals using only the highest quality materials available.

feeds.title: Independent Golf Reviews
feeds.description: Have you ever wanted real golfers' true, unbiased reviews and opinions on a particular piece of golf equipment before you buy it? That is exactly what we give you here at Independent Golf Reviews. With over 1000 products thoroughly tested and reviewed, we believe we have a deeper insight into golf equipment than your average golfer and we want to share this perspective with you.
